ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a circular schematic diagram of the Earth. There is a horizontal diameter inside the circle, which can be regarded as the equator; there is a vertical Earth axis; point O is located on the horizontal diameter, and is also on the oblique terminator line labeled L. Relative to the vertical Earth axis, L is inclined from lower left to upper right, and the inclination angle β is also marked in the upper part of the figure. Then reason: The stem says Jakarta is located at 6°S, and at this time the shadow of an object at noon points north. A noon shadow pointing north means that the Sun is due south of the local place, and the subsolar point should be south of Jakarta, that is, the subsolar point is in the farther-south Southern Hemisphere. Combining the lower-left to upper-right inclination direction of the terminator line L in the figure and the seasonal information that the Southern Hemisphere receives direct solar radiation, it can be judged that L at point O corresponds to the morning line. Point O is also on the equator, and on the equator the morning line corresponds to sunrise time, with local time being 6 o'clock. Therefore, the time corresponding to point O in the figure is 6 o'clock.

<image1>

If at this time in Jakarta (6°S, 106°E), the shadow of an object at noon points north, then what time does point O in the figure correspond to?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中O在水平直径（赤道）上，同时位于斜线L（晨昏线）上，L相对竖直地轴呈左下—右上倾斜。再读题干：雅加达6°S正午影子朝北，说明太阳直射点在更南的南半球。用这一季节信息判断图中该倾斜方向对应的L在O处是晨线。最后利用赤道上晨线对应日出，日出地方时为6时，得出O点时刻为6时。

再推理：题干说雅加达位于6°S，且此时正午物体影子朝北。正午影子朝北，说明太阳在当地正南方，太阳直射点应位于雅加达以南，即太阳直射点在更南的南半球。结合图中晨昏线L左下—右上的倾斜方向和南半球受太阳直射这一季节信息，可以判断L在O点处对应的是晨线。O点又在赤道上，而赤道上晨线对应日出时刻，地方时为6时。因此图中O点对应的时刻是6时。
